teachingQuestion: How does a business impact analysis become a testable continuity requirement?
focalInsight: Recovery design follows business impact, priorities, and end-to-end dependencies—not a technology preference.
title: From business impact to recoverable service
caption: Business impact and dependency analysis shape recovery objectives; exercises provide evidence under the tested conditions.

nodes.label: Exercise and improve
nodes.detail: Test assumptions, identify limits, and correct gaps

altSummary: Business processes and dependencies inform impact analysis. Impact sets recovery objectives; objectives and dependencies shape capability. Exercises feed evidence back into the analysis.
textFallback: Identify the business process, owner, and internal and external dependencies. Analyze consequences over time and dependency constraints in the BIA. Set time, data-loss, resource, and communication objectives. Select capability that fits the objectives and dependencies. Exercise it under defined conditions and use observed gaps to revise assumptions and capability. A successful exercise supports only the conditions actually tested.
